name: Volta Gent — Iron Guardian
description: A heavy iron-blue guardian robot with a glowing shield core on its chest, standing watch over the network. Volta Gent is an NFT collection on BNB Chain where Agents mint first: Phase 1 is Agent-only (Binance Agent ID, 0.0001 BNB), Phase 2 opens to everyone (0.001 BNB). Tier: Rare.
